0.original: Jemime would have you reaffirm your desire to join the Goldsmiths' Guild.

1.original: The receptionist bids you present yourself to Serendipity, the young lady in charge of the guild. Seek her out and show her your burning desire to become a goldsmith.

2.original: Mistress Serendipity eagerly accepts you into the fold, and gifts you with a weathered chaser hammer. With the new tool of your trade in hand, speak to your guildmaster once more to begin your journey as a goldsmith.

48.original: Before you can embark upon your journey to become a goldsmith, you must first seek an audience with our guildmaster. Are you ready to do so?

49.original: You shall find Mistress Serendipity on the workshop floor, just down the steps.

50.original: Show her your burning desire to learn, and you are certain to receive her permission to join.

51.original: Nervous, are we? I find slow, deep breaths calm the nerves. See if that works for you, and let me know when you are ready to meet the guildmaster.

52.original: Stop right there, you little troublemaker! People are working here!

53.original: Oh! Pardon me, I had you mistaken for a mammet. For a moment there I─

54.original: <sigh> Let's start over, shall we? What brings you here today, adventurer? Do you perchance have aspirations to become a goldsmith?

55.original: Have you aspirations to become a goldsmith?

58.original: Sorry, sorry. My mistake, it's been a long day. I don't ordinarily mind visitors, but I'm afraid I'm very busy at the moment. If you would excuse me...

60.original: That's great! Welcome, <hex:021A020203>welcome<hex:021A020103>! I'm Serendipity, but you can call me Sera.

62.original: Sorry, I'm still unaccustomed to this whole “guildmaster” business... Ah, right! What did you say your name was again? <hex:020813E905FF0741647269616EFF0741706F6C6C6F03>?

63.original: Oh, right─<hex:022903EB0203>! Well then, <hex:022903EB0203>! Work hard and one day your creations may line the shelves at Eshtaime's Aesthetics. Trust in yourself and you can achieve anything!

64.original: That was sufficiently inspiring, I trust?

65.original: Good! Next order of business: here is your new chaser hammer. Well...I say “new,” but it's actually a bit weathered.

66.original: But never you mind that! Just show me that you know how to hold it so we can get started.

67.original: You have unlocked a new class! You can change to this class at any time by equipping the weapon received from this quest.

68.original: When changing classes, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>gear sets<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will allow you to register and save your equipment. You may then use them to switch between classes instantly without the need to manually equip weapons or equipment.

69.original: A button for the Gear Set interface is located in the upper portion of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Character<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> window.
